# Hekate Source

This directory contains the license text for the embedded Hekate payload.

- Project: `CTCaer/hekate`
- Source repository: https://github.com/CTCaer/hekate
- Release: `hekate v6.5.2 & Nyx v1.9.2`
- Release page: https://github.com/CTCaer/hekate/releases/tag/v6.5.2
- Embedded binary name: `hekate_ctcaer_6.5.2.bin`

The payload in `include/payload.h` was generated from the local `hekate_ctcaer_6.5.2.bin` file with `tools/bin2payload_h.py`.
